summary: Iteration 7 — Validated the three new features end-to-end: (1) RANKING por período (start/end + month/year) and client-side ordering; (2) DUPLAS (broker-groups CRUD + ranking merging); (3) NOTIFICATIONS (new_sale for master + ranking for corretor after POST /api/sales, read-all + per-id read, bell+badge UI). Backend: 11/11 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_ranking_duplas_notifications.py pass. Frontend (master session_token=qa_session_vinicius_001): RankingCard self-fetches; [ranking-period-select] -> Personalizado reveals [ranking-custom-start]/[ranking-custom-end]; filtering 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 returned 6 rows; order toggles [ranking-order-volume|count|commission] change the right-hand main metric (verified R$ shown for commission, qty-integer for count); NotificationsBell dropdown [notifications-menu] opens; TeamDialog -> [tab-duplas] -> GroupsManager works: created TEST_DUPLA_UI via [group-name-input] + 2x [group-member-*] + [group-save-btn] -> appears in [group-item-*] -> deleted via [group-del-*] + AlertDialog Remover (toast 'Dupla removida.'). Regression: multi-broker 100% rule still returns 400 when splits don't sum to 100. Final DB state verified: 20 sales / 0 broker-groups / 0 goals (no TEST_* leakage).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1709 lines across auth/sales/clients/goals/attachments/export/import/ranking/broker-groups/notifications. Carrying forward prior iteration recommendation to split into routers (sales_router, ranking_router, notifications_router, etc.).
GET /api/ranking with start/end loads up to 5000 sales from Mongo and filters in Python via _in_range. Fine today (20 docs) but should use a Mongo $gte/$lte query on sale_date when data grows.
_post_sale_notifications fetches all sales (to_list(5000)) and iterates every broker goal on every POST /api/sales — O(sales + goals). Acceptable now; batch/cache if volume grows.

Notifications are inserted serially inside a try/except that swallows ALL exceptions and only logs a warning. Good for sale-creation resilience, but silent on bugs. Consider logging at ERROR level with sale_id for observability.

BrokerGroupCreate uses raw str for name/members. Member names are matched case-insensitively by exact strip().lower() against broker.name — if a corretor's war_name is later edited the group silently stops merging. Consider referencing by user_id (owner_id) instead of display name.
/api/notifications caps at 50 items in the response but reads 200 from Mongo first — fine, just make it configurable via query param (?limit=).
NotificationsBell: auto-mark-all-read on open means a user can never see which specific notification is new after re-opening. Consider marking read on individual click/hover instead of on-open.
RankingCard period 'week' uses now.getDay() client-side — timezone-sensitive. Fine for Brazil-only, but if used from a different TZ the week boundary will shift.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of ranking + duplas + notifications flows under test
